prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 3:4 service-card image for an event technology website
Primary request: An immersive event photo activation that lets attendees choose a virtual travel background, shown as a candid premium event scene. A cheerful adult attendee poses naturally beside a sleek freestanding photo booth display. The display shows a clean generic preview of the same person against a vivid Mediterranean seaside destination background, demonstrating instant AI background replacement.
Scene/background: Contemporary indoor brand event venue, subtle physical set lighting, a few softly blurred attendees in the distance.
Style/medium: High-end editorial event photography, realistic and candid.
Composition/framing: Vertical 2:3 portrait, full-height booth and guest framed centrally, leave a little breathing room around the setup; clear read at small card size.
Lighting/mood: Sophisticated cobalt-blue and violet ambient lighting with a gentle warm key light on the person.
Color palette: Deep navy, electric blue, violet, restrained warm skin tones.
Constraints: no visible brand names, no readable screen UI text, no logos, no watermark.
Avoid: stock-photo posing, artificial plastic skin, clutter, futuristic sci-fi helmets, excessive neon, distorted hands, duplicate people
composition: vertical 2:3 portrait; activation and participant central; clear focal point at card size
lighting: cobalt-blue and violet event light with natural warm key light
constraints: no brand names, readable text, logos, or watermark
negative: stock-photo look, tacky excess neon, clutter, warped hands, duplicate people
